item.title: Bella
item.description: Bella is a wonderful companion who has been with us for 2 months. She’s fully vaccinated, spayed, and ready for her forever home. She gets along well with other dogs and loves children.

item.title: Max
item.description: Max is a high-energy dog who needs an active family. He’s great with kids but needs a yard to run around in. He’s fully trained and responds well to commands.

item.title: Luna
item.description: Luna has made incredible progress since arriving at our shelter. She was very shy initially but has blossomed into a confident and loving companion. She’s been adopted by a wonderful family!
